077005 A person is treated as being a member of the claimant’s household whilst temporarily absent

2. 8 weeks3 where paragraph 077006 applies or


3. 26 weeks4 where paragraph 077007 applies.

Concept role: dwp:Applicability.","text":"DMG 77035 distinguishes new claims from 15 May 2019 and continuity protection linked to Pension Credit or pension-age Housing Benefit on 14 May 2019. DMG 77140–77184 distinguish the mixed-age definition, Universal Credit interaction, excluded-partner exceptions and effective dates. The general exclusion is not the complete rule. DMG memo 04/24 paragraphs 15–17 add a protected mixed-age migration route from 8 June 2024: the specified protected couples sent a migration notice may reclaim pension-age Housing Benefit or claim Pension Credit within three months after the relevant UC or HB award ends. That route requires its stated prior entitlement and migration facts; it is not a general right for every mixed-age couple.
